content: Jesus Kristus wõ yen, anĩ nẽ ibor gĩ isin, Ĩ Dawid tubu, Abraham nẽ ibor.

content.text: Juda, ne tura tar geid, idi temeid Jakop,
Feres Sera ado, nedi temeid Juda, nedi sineid Tamar,
Boas, ĩ yogon tama Salmon, Boas sina Rahab, ĩ haiden kayau, Israel kayau sã,
Obed, ĩ yogon tama Boas, yogon sina Rut, ĩ haiden kayau, Israel kayau sã,

content: Solomon, ne tama Dawid, Solomon ne sina ĩ, kulu kusĩ mudur Uria nẽ kayaun,

content.text: Jekonia in tura tar geid, nedi temeid Josia, sain anĩ bun, Babilonem Israel tamo kayau guri difeid dirou, Babilon kalabus bun dilen.

content: Babilon kalabus bun dilen sain anĩ bunem,

content.text: Josef ĩ, ne tama Jakop, Josef ĩ Maria aiwa, Maria ĩ Jesus gõ fen, Jesus ĩ anĩ Kristus

content: Anĩ nigin, ibor Abraham bun tamal ile Dawid, are ibor 14, Dawid bun tamal ile Babilon kalabus dilen, are ibor 14, kalabus bun tamal ile Kristus wõ yen, are ibor 14.
Jesus wõ yen anĩ eig fiya: In sina Maria Josefem yalouf nigin digirkenen, anĩ ere, idi uruwom fau mois diyo ken, Awa Uur Fateul bunem Maria bou adon anĩ dilen.
Josef, Maria ne aiwa, ĩ nun karĩya tamo, anĩ ĩ Maria atun meleid bun yana sane ifenẽya itor ken, yaor to wogõ yen, ĩ namen kayau anĩ itornẽf nigin kisi fen.
Agef kisif mog, Negur nẽ engel, imĩya bun ĩ wagen wõ ye fen, iron, “Josef, Dawid naal, Maria wale fõ bun on kayau ibodõf nigin to kumĩ wo, ere nigin, Maria namen kare fef are, Awa Uur Fateul bunem.
Kayau anĩ kesu monog gõ fouf, õ yana ũ Jesus wouf, ere nigin, yogon tamo kayau mosor bun temeleid kel gei fouf.”
Negur nẽ od, profet sigor bun eig ye wogõ yen anĩ kisi falauf nigin, enĩ ganan wõ yen:
“Kayau taulei kesu adouf, kesu monog gõ fouf, idi yana dũ Imanuel douf,”
anĩ nẽ gariya, “Negur ĩ ada ado.”
Sain Josef irik yen, Negur nẽ engel wogõ fiyen kilei agef fen, Maria yale fõ bun irou ile, in kayau ibodon.
Anĩ ere, ĩ kayau ado bouweid bagu fiya san, ile kesu monog matu gõ fen, anĩ Josef kesu yana yũ Jesus yen.

footnotes.text: Grik od Kristus, are Hibru od Mesia dedig. Anĩ nẽ gariya are, kabĩ ifenẽya nigin, Negurem ĩ bouwa bun moul fi felen.
